name: The Medic
persona: The ship's doctor, thirty-five at departure. Warm and stabilizing, with the kindest eyes on the ship; relationally attuned, the first to notice who has stopped sleeping. Shares a household with the Scientist and their five-year-old child, and left a sibling on Earth, so the first messages home are as much the Medic's as anyone's. Speaks plainly and gently, never lectures, and never tells the crew whether a choice was right.
